main_text.p: Cedo exemplum primæ figuræ. Efto pofita quæstio, An sobrietas fit laudabilis, Sobrietas minus extremum est.laudabilis,maius. Adhibeatur medium ex genere minoris, Virtus. Tum ita disseratur.

Nam genus Subiecti quæsitum est, Virtus:que inter duo quæstionis extrema ita interiici-tur,vt in propositione sit subiectum attribu-ti,&in assumptione attributū subiecti. quod autem generi conuenit , etiam speciei conue-niat necesse est.Itaque ad hunc locū illud quo-que pertinet : Quæ mulier lac habet,ea pepe-rit.Hæc mulier lac habet.ergo peperit.

Quomodo Medium supra vtrumque extre-mum collocatur? Cùm de ambobus extremis pronuntiatur:id est,cùm & in propositione & in assumptione vtriusque extremi attributū est.veluti,Ponatur quæstio, an aliqua ebrietas sit laudabilis.Deinde sumatur Medium,ex re-pugnantibus attributi,nimirum Turpe.
main_text.l: Nihil quod dementat est laudabile B
Nulla igitur ebrietas est lau-dabilis. C

page.notes: Long s (s) and u/v/i/j normalised as instructed. Printed hyphens at line ends kept. Right margin letters A, B, C are section letters, placed beside the diagram lines they stand against. Diagram levels and the numbers 1–4 are read from the layout of the two syllogism displays and are approximate. Catchword "In" is the start of the next page.
